docs.title: 图像复原 / 低层视觉
DPC-Net: Dual-Prior Collaborative Network for All-in-One Image Restoration
docs.text:
• 作者：Zhaokun He, Kangbiao Shi, Axi Niu, Jian Jin, Peng Wu 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.20141v1

All-in-One Image Restoration (AiOIR) aims to handle diverse degradations within a unified model. However, existing methods often overlook image semantics in degradation modeling and lack low-level visual priors during reconstruction, leading to structural distortions and semantic inconsistencies.

docs.title: 大语言模型
ConceptGuard: Benchmarking Context-Sensitive Unlearning in Large Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Sahil Kale, Ian Harris
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.20338v1

Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly require selective removal of harmful or sensitive knowledge, called unlearning, yet existing methods and benchmarks fail to evaluate this capability completely.

docs.title: An Agentic Approach for Active Data Collection, Travel Behavior Modeling, and Weather-Sensitive Demand Prediction
docs.text:
• 作者：Narges Ahmadi, Yubo Jiao, Jônatas Augusto Manzolli, Jiangbo Yu, Luis Miranda-Moreno
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.20320v1

Travel behavior research increasingly combines digital data collection with predictive modeling, yet these stages are often developed and evaluated separately. This study proposes a three-agent workflow integrating conversational data collection, structured data processing, and behavioral prediction.

docs.title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation
docs.text:
• 作者：Adam Fisch, Shubhendu Trivedi, Fantine Huot, William W. Cohen, Michael Kaisers 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.20316v1

Heterogeneous AI systems composed of multiple models, architectures, harnesses, or inference-time settings can improve quality and efficiency by routing queries to the specialist who can answer most effectively at the lowest cost.

docs.title: MidTool: Mid-training Data Synthesis for Agentic Tool Use
docs.text:
• 作者：Fengqing Jiang, Yite Wang, Boyi Liu, Zhaoyang Wang, Canwen Xu 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.20314v1

Mid-training is increasingly recognized as a critical stage for shaping the capabilities of large language models. Recent work has shown that targeted mid-training can strengthen reasoning-intensive abilities such as math and science, and can also improve agentic capabilities in software-engineering settings.

docs.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
docs.text:
• 作者：Qian Kou, Xiaofeng Shi, Xiaosong Qiu, Hua Zhou
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.20281v1

Large language models often fail to answer questions about a bounded document collection when the source documents are not retrieved at inference time. We study this setting as document knowledge internalization: converting a fixed corpus into usable parametric knowledge for retrieval-free question answering.

docs.title: Which Eviction Policy Should an LLM Cache Use? A Systematic Study Across Workloads, Capacities, and Encoders
docs.text:
• 作者：Yash Kulkarni, Shubham Harkare, Arvind Suresh Yogesh Babu
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.DB · arXiv:2608.20280v1

Semantic caches reuse an LLM response when the incoming query embedding lies near a cached query, but proposed eviction policies have rarely been compared under one protocol.

docs.title: Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents
docs.text:
• 作者：Yiyang Feng, Biddut Sarker Bijoy, Niranjan Balasubramanian, Jiawei Zhou
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.20274v1

Large language model (LLM) agents can induce skills from completed tasks and reuse them later to grow more capable with experience. In practice, induced skills may transfer unreliably and can even harm the agent that retrieves them. When agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks remains an open question.

docs.title: Rule-Compliant Visual Spatial Planning for Multimodal Large Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Yu Chen, Ting Lei, Yaoyi Li, Jia Cai, Zhecen Wu 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.20237v1

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) combine linguistic reasoning with visual perception, yet their ability to perform visual spatial planning under explicit or previously unseen rule constraints remains underexplored.

docs.title: ContractScrub: A benchmark for final review of legal contracts
docs.text:
• 作者：Yejin Bang, Kirsty Fielding, Brandan Oliver, Brian Birke, Nabeel Seedat 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.20204v1

Legal work, with its heavy reliance on processing large amounts of text, is often considered one of the domains most exposed to the use of LLMs. Contract ``scrubbing,'' the final review of transactional agreements for errors and inconsistencies, is a particularly suitable task for automation, because it is routine, pai…

docs.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
docs.text:
• 作者：Mengru Wang, Haozhe Luo, Zhenqian Xu, Zhixiang Cui, Haoming Xu 等 9 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.20202v1

Memory has become a key component of large language models, enabling them to retain information and learn from long-term interactions. However, existing memory benchmarks mainly evaluate whether information is correctly extracted, stored, and retrieved, while largely overlooking how retrieved memories reshape model rea…

docs.title: Decoding silent reading from non-invasive EEG
docs.text:
• 作者：Ingo Marquardt, Anthilia Alchanat, Priyanka Jain
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2608.20186v1

Non-invasive decoding of inner speech faces a fundamental data problem: a corpus pairing brain activity with a person's spontaneous inner monologue cannot be collected, and the available proxy paradigms (cued repetitive and retrospectively reported generative inner speech) are slow to acquire, poorly time-locked, and s…

docs.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
docs.text:
• 作者：Atsuyuki Miyai, Kiyoharu Aizawa, Toshihiko Yamasaki
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.20169v1

We present a novel approach to efficient LLM agent harness optimization through adaptive validation task selection. Harness optimization iteratively rewrites the harness code based on validation performance, enabling substantial performance gains without updating the underlying model weights.

docs.title: 具身智能
DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Siyuan Ma, Boshi Zhang, Yutian Zhang, Qinglian Wu, Jiaqi Zhai 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.20114v1

Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions.

docs.title: Planning-Oriented End-to-End Autonomous Driving: Architectures, Evaluation, and Emerging Paradigms
docs.text:
• 作者：Yanchen Guan, Xingcheng Liu, Bin Rao, Chengyue Wang, Guofa Li 等 10 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.20111v1

End-to-end autonomous driving has evolved from camera-to-control regression toward planning-oriented systems that use structured representations, trajectory-level outputs, and increasingly realistic evaluation protocols.

docs.title: EXIMO: VLM Guided Exploration of VLA Policies
docs.text:
• 作者：Bhavya Sukhija, Oliver Groth, Mohit Shridhar, Tim Hertweck, Michael Bloesch 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.19891v1

How to efficiently finetune robot policies to learn new tasks on the fly? State of the art robotic manipulation policies are based on behaviour cloning of large vision-language-action (VLA) models with billions of parameters on huge teleoperation datasets.

docs.title: Towards general embodied intelligence: integrating large language models, knowledge bases, and reasoning capabilities to build the next generation of AI agents
docs.text:
• 作者：Fujiang Yuan, Xia Huang, Lusheng Wang, Jun Ding, Zhen Tian 等 10 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.19794v1

The convergence of large language models (LLMs), structured knowledge bases (KBs), and reasoning ability (RA) presents a promising trajectory toward general embodied intelligence (GEI).

docs.title: SafeBranch: Branch-Pair Safety Alignment for Embodied Agents
docs.text:
• 作者：Hyunse Lee, Jiwoo Jeong, Haneul Lee, Kyochul Jang, Youngjae Yu 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.19729v1

Vision-language-model-based embodied agents can complete instructed tasks but often violate safety constraints in the process, a problem recently framed as interactive safety.

docs.title: OrthoSkillVLA: Continual Skill Learning via Gradient-Informed Skill Subspace Adaptation
docs.text:
• 作者：Jiaqi Wang, Zhou Fang, Qiongfeng Shi, Yi Zhou
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.19589v1

Pretrained Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for robot learning, but sequentially adapting them to diverse skills can perturb the representations and velocity mappings used by previous skills, leading to catastrophic forgetting.

本期共收录 19 篇。

Cardiac MRI Through-Plane Super-Resolution Guided by Reference and Memory

Clinical cardiac MRI is commonly acquired with high in-plane resolution but coarse through-plane resolution to reduce scan time and accommodate breath-hold and cardiac-motion constraints, which limits 3D analysis and diagnostic accuracy.

docs.title: PhyMRI-SR: Toward Physics-Aware MRI Image Super-Resolution
docs.text:
• 作者：Lihua Wei, Huatong Gao, Jia Gong, Zhiyu Tan, Hao Li 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-07-07 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.06238v1

Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) super-resolution is vital for improving diagnostic accessibility, yet most methods treat it as a deterministic mapping from a fixed low-resolution input to a high-resolution target.

docs.title: Format-Controlled Multi-Scale JPEG Compression Response Analysis for Image-Level Forgery Screening
docs.text:
• 作者：Sujith K Mandala
  • 提交：2026-07-07 · 分类 eess.IV · arXiv:2607.06615v1

Image forgery detection is a critical task in digital forensics, yet many deep-learning localization approaches are typically GPU-accelerated and computationally heavier than handcrafted screening methods.

docs.title: Realistic Compound-Lens Defocus Blur Synthesis
docs.text:
• 作者：Yunkyu Lee, Woohyeok Kim, Sunghyun Cho
  • 提交：2026-07-07 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.05837v1

Defocus blur degrades fine image structures and limits visual perception, which can adversely affect downstream vision tasks. Although recent deep learning deblurring methods have achieved strong performance, their effectiveness depends on training data and often degrades across cameras and lenses due to limited optica…

docs.title: Optimized Adaptive Loop Filter in Versatile Video Coding
docs.text:
• 作者：Xuewei Meng, Jiaqi Zhang, Chuanmin Jia, Xinfeng Zhang, Shanshe Wang 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-07 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.05737v2

In the Versatile Video Coding~(VVC) standard, adaptive loop filter~(ALF), including Geometry transformation-based Adaptive Loop Filter~(GALF) and Cross Component Adaptive Loop Filter~(CCALF), plays an essential role in reducing compression artifacts.

docs.title: 大语言模型
Accurate, Interdisciplinary and Transparent Structure-property Understanding with Deep Native Structural Reasoning
docs.text:
• 作者：Chen Tang, Yizhou Wang, Jianyu Wu, Lintao Wang, Shixiang Tang 等 29 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.07708v1

Structure-property relationships are foundational to biology, chemistry and materials science, where function, reactivity and physical response emerge from spatial, chemical and periodic organization.

docs.title: Co-LMLM: Continuous-Query Limited Memory Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Yair Feldman, Linxi Zhao, Nathan Godey, Dongyoung Go, Yilun Hua 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.07707v1

Limited memory language models (LMLMs) externalize factual knowledge during pretraining to a knowledge base (KB), rather than memorizing it in their weights. During generation, the model then fetches knowledge from the KB as needed.

docs.title: From Noisy Traces to Root Causes: Structural Trajectory Analysis and Causal Extraction for Agent Optimization
docs.text:
• 作者：Ying Chang, Jiahang Xu, Xuan Feng, Chenyuan Yang, Peng Cheng 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.07702v1

The optimization of long-horizon agents increasingly relies on reflection-based mechanisms, where a large language model (LLM) acts as an optimizer to diagnose agent failures and improve agent policies.

docs.title: Breaking Database Lock-in: Agentic Regeneration of High Performance Storage Readers for Database Bypass
docs.text:
• 作者：Victor Giannakouris, Immanuel Trummer
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.DB · arXiv:2607.07696v1

Analytical workloads operating on data stored in external database systems face a fundamental bottleneck: data access is guarded entirely by the database driver, like JDBC or ODBC, forcing all reads through query execution and other driver layers that are not designed for bulk columnar analytics.

docs.title: SkillCenter: A Large-Scale Source-Grounded Skill Library for Autonomous AI Agents
docs.text:
• 作者：Tianming Sha, Yue Zhao, Lichao Sun, Yushun Dong
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.07676v1

Autonomous AI agents can execute complex tasks with limited human review, yet they often lack the grounded operational knowledge to make their outputs not just executable but correct, secure, and maintainable.

docs.title: MedPMC: A Systematic Framework for Scaling High-Fidelity Medical Multimodal Data for Foundation Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Hyunjae Kim, Dain Kim, Pan Xiao, Serina S. Applebaum, Younjoon Chung 等 28 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.07673v1

Medicine is inherently multimodal, requiring clinicians to synthesize information across diverse data streams. Yet the development of multimodal foundation models is constrained by limited access to large-scale, high-quality clinical data.

docs.title: Does Bielik Know What It Doesn't Know? Activation Dispersion Separates Entity Familiarity from Factual Reliability Across Model Scale
docs.text:
• 作者：Grzegorz Brzezinka
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.07670v1

Large language models hallucinate most about entities they have never seen. We ask whether a model's activations betray entity familiarity before a single answer token is generated, and whether that signal predicts the factual reliability of the answers.

docs.title: DiaLLM: An Investigation into the Robustness-Generation Gap in English Dialect Adaptation
docs.text:
• 作者：Jordan Painter, Dipankar Srirag, Adarsh Kappiyath, Diptesh Kanojia, Aditya Joshi 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.07669v1

Large language models increasingly \emph{understand} dialectal English, yet still \emph{produce} only standard, US-leaning English, leaving dialectal generation, the harder half of the problem, largely unaddressed.

docs.title: Future Confidence Distillation in Large Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Sahil Kale
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.07626v1

Reliable confidence estimation is essential for deploying large language models (LLMs) in confidence-aware systems, where downstream decisions such as retrieval, tool use, and adaptive computation depend on accurately estimating answer reliability.

docs.title: CARLA-GS: Decoupling Representation, Reasoning, and Physics Simulation for Autonomous Driving Corner-Case Synthesis
docs.text:
• 作者：Kaicong Huang, Meng Ma, Ruimin Ke
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.07601v1

Safety evaluation for autonomous driving is dominated by rare, safety-critical interactions, motivating simulators that can deliberately synthesize corner cases with photorealistic observations.

docs.title: Think Big, Search Small: Where Capacity Matters in Hierarchical Search Agents?
docs.text:
• 作者：Qinnan Cai, Yibo Zhao, Xiang Li
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.07548v1

Large language model based search agents increasingly adopt multi-agent architectures in which a main agent decomposes a complex question into sub-queries and dispatches them to parallel sub-agents.

docs.title: A Unified Detection Framework for AI-Related Content and Artifacts
docs.text:
• 作者：Xifeng Zhang, Tao Hu, Yijie Peng, Wan Tian
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 stat.ML · arXiv:2607.07527v1

Artificial intelligence (AI) is a double-edged sword: while it has achieved remarkable success across a wide range of domains, its deployment also calls for effective oversight and regulation, for which the detection of AI-related content and artifacts is perhaps the most direct and cost-effective approach.

docs.title: 具身智能
Dual Latent Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Hongyu Qu, Jianzhe Gao, Xiaobin Hu, Shaohuan Yang, Xinlei Yu 等 9 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.07608v1

Mainstream Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predict actions primarily from the current observation under a Markovian assumption, thus struggling with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks.

docs.title: Smooth Operator: A Real-Time Sampling-Based Algorithm for Kinematic Hand Retargeting
docs.text:
• 作者：Robert Jomar Malate, Erik Bauer, Norica Bacuieti, Stefanos Charalambous, Elvis Nava 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.07491v1

Advances in learning-based robotic manipulation, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and Video Action Models (VAMs), heavily rely on high-quality teleoperation data. Their capabilities are strictly upper-bounded by the quality of the underlying human demonstrations.

docs.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
docs.text:
• 作者：Xinjie Wang, Liu Liu, Taojun Ding, Andrew Choi, Chaodong Huang 等 12 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.07459v1

We present EmbodiedGen V2, a generative 3D world engine for building executable sim-ready environments for embodied intelligence. Sim-ready 3D asset generation has advanced rapidly, yet assembling such assets into policy-ready task environments remains largely manual, limiting scalable closed-loop learning.

docs.title: Multi-Agent Robotic Control with Onboard Vision-Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Kajetan Rachwał, Maciej Majek, Bartłomiej Boczek, Jakub Matejczyk, Dominik Matejkowski 等 9 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.MA · arXiv:2607.07403v1

Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Vision Language Action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic control. Yet, they face significant challenges regarding explainability, generalization, and compute requirements.

docs.title: Behavior Foundations for Quadruped Robots: ABot-C0 Technical Report
docs.text:
• 作者：Xufeng Zhao, Fuzhi Yang, Jianhui Chen, Li Gao, Zhang Meng 等 18 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.07370v1

In embodied intelligence systems, the motion controller serves as the critical bridge between semantic reasoning and physical execution. Humanoid control has progressed rapidly through large-scale human motion-capture data and motion-tracking paradigm.

docs.title: TouchWorld: A Predictive and Reactive Tactile Foundation Model for Dexterous Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Jianyi Zhou, Feiyang Hong, Yunhao Li, Yicheng Zhao, Yongjue Cen 等 12 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.07287v1

Dexterous manipulation in everyday environments requires both anticipation and reaction: a robot must predict how contact should evolve while rapidly correcting local errors caused by slip, misalignment, unstable grasping, or force mismatch.

docs.title: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators
docs.text:
• 作者：Christian Oefinger, Finn Rasmus Schäfer, Korbinian Moller, Mattia Piccinini, Johannes Betz
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.07196v1

Across robotics, World Models (WMs) are increasingly used to evaluate action policies by simulating the consequences of actions in an imagined world, and returning a success or safety verdict. Yet a verdict is only as trustworthy as the WM that produced it, and the WM itself needs to be certified.

docs.title: GeoProp: Grounding Robot State in Vision for Generalist Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Guoyang Zhao, Quanhao Qian, Gongjie Zhang, Wenhao Li, Jiuniu Wang 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.07101v1

Proprioception is fundamental to robotic manipulation, yet standard fusion methods often treat it as an isolated vector lacking explicit alignment with visual tokens.

docs.title: GemNav: Discrete-Token Visual Robot Navigation using a Multimodal Large Language Model
docs.text:
• 作者：Peter Bohm, Saimunur Rahman, Abdelwahed Khamis, Sagun Man Singh Shrestha, Chris McCool 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-08 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.06882v1

Visual navigation policies built on large pretrained models have so far followed a common recipe: a dedicated visual encoder, a bespoke action head, and training on thousands of hours of cross-embodiment datasets. We ask whether this recipe is necessary.

docs.title: Vision Language Action (VLA) Models for Unmanned Aerial Robotics and Bimanual Manipulation: A Review
docs.text:
• 作者：Inkyu Sa, Chanoh Park, Hea-Min Lee, Donghee Noh, Ho Seok Ahn
  • 提交：2026-07-07 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.06706v1

Vision Language Action (VLA) models unify visual perception, natural-language understanding, and action generation within a single foundation model, allowing a robot to follow instructions such as fold the towel or fly to the red building directly from camera images.

docs.title: SPEAR: A Simulator for Photorealistic Embodied AI Research
docs.text:
• 作者：Mike Roberts, Renhan Wang, Rushikesh Zawar, Rachith Dey-Prakash, Quentin Leboutet 等 13 人
  • 提交：2026-07-07 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.06701v1

Interactive simulators have become powerful tools for training embodied agents and generating synthetic visual data, but existing photorealistic simulators suffer from limited generality, programmability, and rendering speed.

docs.title: NativeMEM: Native Memory Compression for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Ziye Wang, Modi Shi, Chaojun Ni, Jiazhi Yang, Mengdi Li 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-07-07 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.06678v1

How can pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models retain long-horizon visual histories with high-frequency updates without sacrificing efficiency? Existing approaches rely on external memory management, which restrains either the memory horizon or the reactiveness of pretrained policies.

本期共收录 29 篇。

docs.title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
docs.text:
• 作者：Yifan Zhou, Qihao Yang, Yan Li, Donggang Li, Xiru Hu 等 17 人
  • 提交：2026-07-09 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.08758v1

Scientific ideas rarely start from a blank page. They inherit mechanisms, repair known limitations, and recombine pieces of earlier work, much like biological genomes. Current benchmarks still say little about whether AI systems can follow this inheritance structure.

Low-rank factorization is widely used to compress neural networks, but modern models are often not naturally amenable to aggressive factorization without significant accuracy loss.

docs.title: AUTOPILOT VQA: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Incident-Centric Dashcam Understanding
docs.text:
• 作者：Siddharth Damodharan, Radhika Gupta, Ali Alshami, Ryan Rabinowitz, Jugal Kalita
  • 提交：2026-07-09 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.08745v1

Recent advances in Vision-Language Models, Large Language Models, and Multimodal Large Language Models have improved autonomous driving tasks such as scene understanding, decision making, trajectory prediction, and visual question answering.

docs.title: Workflow as Knowledge: Semantic Persistence for LLM-Mediated Workflows
docs.text:
• 作者：Emanuele Quinto, Carlo Andrea Rozzi, Francesco Zanitti

  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 eess.IV · arXiv:2607.14894v1

Plug-and-play proximal gradient descent (PnP-PGD) enables flexible image reconstruction by using denoisers as implicit priors. In practice, these denoisers are often deployed outside their training domains.

docs.title: 大语言模型
Partition, Prompt, Aggregate: Statistical Self-Consistency in Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Patrik Wolf, Thomas Kleine Buening, Andreas Krause, Celestine Mendler-Dünner
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.15277v1

In-context learning is commonly interpreted as a form of conditional inference, in which the prompt specifies a context and the model's output is treated as an estimate of the corresponding conditional distribution. If this interpretation holds, then LLM estimates should satisfy basic probabilistic identities.

docs.title: SearchOS-V1: Towards Robust Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration
docs.text:
• 作者：Yuyao Zhang, Junjie Gao, Zhengxian Wu, Jiaming Fan, Jin Zhang 等 14 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.15257v1

Recent advances in Tool-Integrated Large Language Models have made web search a core capability of information-seeking agents. However, as interaction histories grow, agents increasingly struggle to track task progress.

docs.title: teLLMe Why (Ain't Nothing but a Jam): Exploratory Causal Analysis of Urban Driving Data
docs.text:
• 作者：Qiwei Li, Jorge Ortiz
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.15254v1

Traffic agencies now have access to large volumes of video-derived data for studying safety and congestion. Most of these data are observational and collected without interventions, which makes causal questions such as "How would rain change traffic density?" difficult to answer.

docs.title: When Words Are Safe But Actions Kill: Probing Physical Danger Beyond Text Safety in Hidden-State Risk Space
docs.text:
• 作者：Weimeng Wang, Ziqiang Wang, Zihang Zhan, Chuanpu Fu, Qi Li 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.15218v1

Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as high-level planners for embodied agents, where linguistically benign instructions can become unsafe once grounded in the physical world. We study whether this physically grounded danger is the same safety problem as ordinary text-level content danger.

docs.title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
docs.text:
• 作者：Maya Varma, Jean-Benoit Delbrouck, Sophie Ostmeier, Akshay Chaudhari, Curtis Langlotz
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.15216v1

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often introduce errors when generating image captions, resulting in misaligned image-text pairs. Our work focuses on a class of captioning errors that we refer to as systematic misalignments, where a recurring error in MLLM-generated captions is closely associated with the prese…

docs.title: MM-IssueLoc: A Controlled Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Evidence in Multimodal Repository-Level Issue Localization
docs.text:
• 作者：Shaoxiong Zhan, Shi Hu, Boyu Feng, Hai Lin, Andrew Gong 等 10 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.SE · arXiv:2607.15205v1

Real repository issues routinely include visual evidence such as screenshots, error dialogs, rendered UI states, and logs, yet repository-level issue localization is evaluated mostly as a text-only task.

docs.title: Self-Evolving Human-Centered Framework for Explainable Depression Symptom Annotation
docs.text:
• 作者：Hoang-Loc Cao, Van Pham, Truong Thanh Hung Nguyen, Phuc Truong Loc Nguyen, Phuc Ho 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.15202v1

Annotation quality is a major bottleneck in building reliable and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) systems for mental health research. In depression-related datasets, labels are often assigned without structured evidence, symptom-level justification, or traceable alignment with the criteria of the Diagnostic a…

docs.title: Mask-Aware Policy Gradients for Diffusion Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Haran Raajesh, Kulin Shah, Adam Klivans, Philipp Krähenbühl
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.15200v1

Reinforcement learning has proven effective for improving reasoning in large language models, but extending it to Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) remains challenging due to the intractability of the log-likelihood estimation.

docs.title: Can We Trust Item Response Theory for AI Evaluation?
docs.text:
• 作者：Han Jiang, Sunbeom Kwon, Jinwen Luo, Ziang Xiao, Susu Zhang
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.15190v1

AI benchmarks increasingly leverage item-level statistical models, particularly item response theory (IRT), to estimate model capabilities, rank systems, select informative examples, and diagnose benchmark quality.

docs.title: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Scientific Visualization Literacy
docs.text:
• 作者：Patrick Phuoc Do, Chau M. Ta, Chaoli Wang
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.15176v1

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interpret visualizations, yet current evaluations remain largely chart-centric and provide limited evidence of understanding of scientific visualization (SciVis).

docs.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation
docs.text:
• 作者：Byeongho Heo, Jaehui Hwang, Sangdoo Yun, Dongyoon Han
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2607.15161v1

On-policy distillation is an alternative post-training method in reinforcement learning that alleviates the constraints imposed by reward models by providing token-level supervision from a teacher model.

docs.title: Grokipedia vs Wikipedia: An LLM-Based Audit of Political Neutrality along Ideologies
docs.text:
• 作者：Filippos Vlahos, Guillaume Bied, Tijl De Bie
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.15146v1

Online encyclopedias shape political opinion and, through it, democratic discourse. In late 2025, Grokipedia was released, an encyclopedia written entirely by the LLM Grok.

docs.title: 具身智能
RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
docs.text:
• 作者：Yunfan Jiang, Yevgen Chebotar, Ruijie Zheng, Fengyuan Hu, Yunhao Ge 等 11 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.15275v1

Recent robot foundation models operate with single-step or short-history visuomotor context. We introduce Test-Time-Training Robot Policies (RoboTTT), a robot model and training recipe that scale visuomotor context to 8K timesteps, three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies, without growing inference la…

docs.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
docs.text:
• 作者：Qi Li, Xingyi Yang, Xinchao Wang
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2607.15207v1

World-action models (WAMs) are emerging as a promising foundation for embodied control: rather than predicting actions alone, they learn representations that couple action generation with future world prediction.

docs.title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
docs.text:
• 作者：Weishuai Zeng, Kangning Yin, Xiaojie Niu, Shunlin Lu, Weixiang Zhong 等 18 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.15163v1

Humanoid control requires natural whole-body coordination, precise real-time responses to control signals, and robust generalization across diverse environmental contexts, making it a cornerstone for generalist embodied agents.

docs.title: CosFly-VLA: A Spatially Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Tracking
docs.text:
• 作者：Ruilong Ren, Songsheng Cheng, Yunpeng Zhou, Hanxuan Chen, Xiangyue Wang 等 12 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.15004v1

Dynamic target tracking is essential for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) operating in complex urban environments, where both the target and the camera viewpoint change continuously.

docs.title: AeroAct: Action-Centered World-Action Models for Language-Conditioned Quadrotor Flight
docs.text:
• 作者：Xinhong Zhang, Qiyuan Zhu, Yubo Huang, Haolin Chen, Runqing Wang 等 11 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.14997v1

Language-conditioned quadrotor flight requires a policy to ground semantic goals, anticipate the visual consequences of ego-motion, and output control references that remain smooth and dynamically executable under rapidly changing first-person views.

docs.title: Towards Human-like Physical Intelligence: LifelongVision-Language-Action Learning for Robotic Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Yao He, Gan Sun, Wenqi Liang, Fazeng Li, Yang Cong
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.14852v1

Similar to the natural capabilities of humans to sequentially learn new tasks, robots with Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models should possess lifelong learning ability to learn a new task when deployed in open-world environments.

docs.title: FoMoVLA: Bridging Visual Foresight and Motion Guidance for Vision-Language-Action Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Wei Li, Peijin Jia, Yuan Ma, Xuefeng Jiang, Titong Jiang 等 12 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.14739v1

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in visuomotor policy learning, yet remain fundamentally reactive, mapping current observations and language to actions without explicit forward prediction of world dynamics.

docs.title: Lights, Camera, Malfunction: When Illumination Robustness Leaves VLA Models Blind to Color
docs.text:
• 作者：Marino Watanabe, Takami Sato, Kentaro Yoshioka
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.14698v1

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation; however, their transition to real-world environments reveals vulnerabilities to minor environmental perturbations.

docs.title: Reflex: Real-Time VLA Control through Streaming Inference
docs.text:
• 作者：Yuanchun Guo, Bingyan Liu
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.14695v1

Flow matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise precise continuous control, but their iterative denoising nature introduces fundamental incompatibilities with real-time robotics: global timestep injection invalidates KV-caching, forcing a choice between slow $O(N^2)$ re-computation or mathematically incorrect…

docs.title: NavCMPO: Critic-Guided MeanFlow Policy Optimization for Adaptive Navigation
docs.text:
• 作者：Junjie An, Yi Wu, Xiao Liu, Yiqun Zhou, Yuechen Wu 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.14643v1

End-to-end diffusion-based policies have demonstrated strong performance in mapless visual navigation, but their iterative denoising process introduces substantial inference latency, while behavior cloning limits performance to the quality of expert demonstrations.

docs.title: Action QFormer: Structured Representation Shaping under Action Supervision in Vision-Language-Action Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Yufeng Ji, Wenhao Tang, Haoyi Niu, Koushil Sreenath, Yi Wu 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.14635v1

Action supervision in vision-language-action (VLA) models is often treated as a downstream objective for learning action prediction. In this paper, we study it instead as a force that shapes inherited multimodal representations.

docs.title: Knowing You at First Glance: Inferring Apparent Personality from Faces
docs.text:
• 作者：Shuhuan Chen, Xiangyu Zhu, Weisong Zhao, Haichao Shi, Xiao-Yu Zhang 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-16 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.14631v1

Inferring apparent personality from facial images is important in social scenarios for embodied agents in human-robot interaction. Unlike inferring intrinsic personality traits via conversation, this task models first-impression personality perception based solely on facial appearance before interaction begins.

Co-addition and Subtraction of Undersampled Images
docs.text:
• 作者：Matan Schlanger, Barak Zackay
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 astro-ph.IM · arXiv:2607.18054v1

In astronomical imaging surveys, repeated observations of the same sky patches are taken in order to obtain deeper images and detect new sources. This is the case in the search for many transient phenomena, such as supernovae, gravitational wave (GW) optical counterparts and other cataclysmic variables.

docs.title: Luminosity-Adaptive Contrast Enhancement Using CLAHE for Retinal Fundus Images with Quantitative Validation and Comparative Analysis
docs.text:

  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 eess.IV · arXiv:2607.17691v1

Background: Retinal fundus imaging is central to the early diagnosis of sight-threatening conditions including diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, and retinal vein occlusion.

docs.text:
• 作者：Ao Li, Yapeng Du, Yi Xin, Lei Zhu, Le Zhang 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.17612v1

Continuous diffusion models have become the dominant paradigm for photo-realistic image Super-Resolution (SR), but they typically formulate reconstruction as continuous signal-level denoising and incorporate semantic priors through external conditioning modules.

docs.title: Does Super-Resolution Preserve Defect Evidence? A Low-False-Call Benchmark for Semiconductor Inspection
docs.text:
• 作者：Shaoliang Yang, Jun Wang
  • 提交：2026-07-19 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.17401v1

Super-resolution can make inspection images appear sharper without preserving the evidence needed to detect a defect. We study this failure mode with a benchmark that separates reconstruction from detection and evaluates both at a predeclared low false-positive rate.

docs.title: 大语言模型
Automated Discovery Has No Universally Superior Harness
docs.text:
• 作者：Akshat Gupta, Jermaine Lei, Alexander Lu, Gopala Anumanchipalli, Leshem Choshen
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.18235v1

Autonomous discovery systems such as OpenEvolve and TTT-Discover are often used as general-purpose harnesses. However, in practice these are composite systems combining several design choices about archives, parent selection, exploration, and budget allocation into a single recipe.

docs.title: It's Not What You Say, It's How You Say It: Evaluating LLM Responses to Expressions of Belief
docs.text:
• 作者：Kevin Du, Clara Kümpel, Michelle Wastl, Alex Warstadt
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.18232v1

Users frequently express their beliefs to large language models (LLMs). In some situations, the LLM should accept these contextual beliefs as true. In others, they should stick to their prior knowledge.

docs.title: Vector Search As Nearest Neighbor Matching: RAG-based Policy Learning in Causal Inference
docs.text:
• 作者：Masahiro Kato, Taka Kato
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 econ.EM · arXiv:2607.18225v1

We propose one-step and two-step methods for policy learning with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We formulate RAG-based action selection under the potential outcome framework.

docs.title: PPL-Factory: Task-Aware and Budget-Aware Data Selection from Language Modeling to Reasoning
docs.text:
• 作者：Hang Zhang, Warren J. Gross
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.18199v1

Not all training samples contribute equally to large language model fine-tuning. Selecting informative training samples can reduce the computational cost while preserving downstream performance. Many existing data selection methods rely on indirect heuristics, such as data quality, diversity or reasoning trace length.

docs.title: VEHBench: A Stage-Local Diagnostic Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Vibration Energy Harvester Design
docs.text:
• 作者：Depeng Su, Yuyu Luo, Guobiao Hu
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.18181v1

Battery-free Internet of Things (IoT) requires iterative design of vibration energy harvesters (VEHs) under coupled physical constraints, while LLMs are emerging as interface layers for engineering workflows.

docs.title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications
docs.text:

  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2607.18171v1

Real-time multimodal applications, including voice agents and interactive video generation, compose heterogeneous models into pipelines whose efficient deployment requires application-specific decisions about placement, streaming, and intra-model parallelism.

docs.title: OR Else: A Differentiable Trust Region for Policy Optimization
docs.text:
• 作者：Chinmay Rane, Kanishka Tyagi, Michael Manry
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2607.18163v1

PPO and the GRPO baseline studied here use clipped surrogate objectives whose favorable-direction saturation introduces an abrupt change in the scalar objective's derivative. We ask whether Output Reset (OR), a smooth one-sided saturation rule, offers a useful alternative for large language model post-training.

docs.title: LLMs and Agentic AI Systems for Smart Grids: A Tutorial on Architectures and Applications
docs.text:
• 作者：Daniela Rojas, Abdulwahab Albassam, Aidan G. Leung, Jett Ngo, Ryan Luo 等 14 人
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 eess.SY · arXiv:2607.18147v1

Large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI systems have evolved from natural language tasks to using external tools to plan, retrieve, and act in technical domains.

docs.title: Do Language Models Dream of Binding Molecules? Benchmarking LLMs under Spatial Constraints
docs.text:
• 作者：Thomas MacDougall, Maksim Kuznetsov, Roman Schutski, Rim Shayakhmetov, Maxim Malkov 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2607.18144v1

Structure-based drug design (SBDD) leverages the 3D structure of protein targets, often complemented by other spatial constraints, to generate candidate binding molecules.

docs.title: SGA: Plug&Play Geometric Verification for Educational Video Synthesis
docs.text:
• 作者：Lopez Jhon, Hinojosa Carlos, Ghanem Bernard
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.18116v1

Recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate executable code for pedagogical animations using libraries such as Manim. However, ensuring spatial correctness and visual legibility remains challenging, as existing frameworks emphasize pedagogical content while overlooking geometric occlusions.

docs.title: How Does Alignment Tuning Shape Representations of Sycophancy and Related Cue-Induced Biases in LLMs?
docs.text:
• 作者：Prakhar Gupta, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Florent Draye, Bernhard Schölkopf, Zhijing Jin
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.18114v1

Modern LLMs are alarmingly susceptible to surprisingly simple immaterial changes of input prompts: a casual hint, an incorrectly labeled few-shot example, or a fake prior assistant turn often flips an originally correct answer.

docs.title: LLM-as-a-Coach: Experiential Learning for Non-Verifiable Tasks
docs.text:
• 作者：Tianzhu Ye, Li Dong, Guanheng Chen, He Zhu, Xun Wu 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2607.18110v1

Reinforcement learning (RL) on open-ended tasks compresses an LLM's rubric-based evaluation into a scalar reward, discarding rich textual feedback and conflating responses with distinct quality profiles.

docs.title: 具身智能
Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
docs.text:
• 作者：Gaoyue Zhou, Zichen Jeff Cui, Ada Langford, Bowen Tan, Yann LeCun 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.18236v1

Pretrained dense visual features from Vision Transformers (ViTs) are powerful yet have been underutilized in robot learning. Modern robot policies either compress each observation into a single global token, or rely on visual backbones trained from scratch, sacrificing both fine-grained spatial detail and the benefits…

docs.title: FM-VLA: Force-based Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models in Contact-Rich Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Ruicheng Li, Qixiu Li, Ruichun Ma, Yu Deng, Lin Luo 等 11 人
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.18231v1

Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved impressive generalization in robotic manipulation, and recent memory-augmented VLAs have relaxed the Markovian assumption by conditioning on past images or language summaries.

docs.title: UniETP: Unifying Environments for Generalizable Embodied Task Planning
docs.text:
• 作者：Peiran Xu, Jiaqi Zheng, Ziyou Wang, Yadong Mu
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.18062v1

This paper focuses on the problem of Embodied Task Planning, where an agent is required to execute a sequence of atomic actions within an interactive environment to complete a user-specified task.

docs.title: Closing the Loop in Humanoid VLA: Persistent 3D Object Tokens for Verifiable Loco-Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Peng Ren, Haoyang Ge, Jiang Zhao, Cong Huang, Yukun Shi 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.18016v1

Vision-language-action policies are a promising foundation for general robot control, but long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires the robot to treat task objects as persistent physical entities across movement, contact, occlusion, and recovery.

docs.title: RynnBrain 1.1: Towards More Capable and Generalizable Embodied Foundation Model
docs.text:
• 作者：Kehan Li, Bohan Hou, Minghao Zhu, Tianyi Zhang, Zesen Cheng 等 30 人
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.17977v1

We present RynnBrain 1.1, a family of embodied foundation models spanning 2B, 9B, and 122B-A10B scales. Trained with a unified spatio-temporal and physically grounded framework, RynnBrain 1.1 supports embodied perception, spatial reasoning, localization, and planning.

docs.title: PGN: Design and Implementation of a Vision-Language Navigation System Based on Pangu Multimodal Foundation Model
docs.text:

  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.17806v1

Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to interpret a natural-language instruction and predict actions from temporally ordered visual observations.

docs.title: Reasoning as a Double-Edged Sword: Architecture and Cross-Stage Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Models

Does adding a reasoning step make a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model more robust to perturbation? Intuitively, a policy that reasons before acting should absorb a perturbed input better than one that maps observations directly to actions.

docs.title: From Sign Language Generation to Humanoid Execution: Vision-Language Guided Retargeting with Collision Mitigation
docs.text:
• 作者：Nabeela Khan, Bowen Wu, Runwu Shi, Benjamin Yen, Takeshi Ashizawa 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-07-20 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.17769v1

Recent sign language generation (SLG) systems increasingly output dense 3D body representations, which better preserve full-body kinematics and geometry for downstream embodiment on humanoid robots. However, these generated motions frequently exhibit self-intersections such as hand-hand and hand-torso penetration.

docs.title: Reward-Driven LLM Agent Workflows: Synthesizing POMDP Routing and Self-Correction for Autonomous Decision-Making
docs.text:

  • 提交：2026-07-19 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.17038v1

This paper addresses key technical challenges in current large language model (LLM) agent applications, including long-horizon planning, sparse reward attribution, and dynamic environmental interaction, by designing and optimizing an intelligent agent workflow.

docs.title: 图像复原 / 低层视觉
Texture++: Elevating 3D Asset Texture Resolution with a Region-Aware Diffusion Model
docs.text:
• 作者：Shuaiwei Wang, Shi Li, Jieting Xu, Yuchi Huo, Qi Wang 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.21504v1

Numerous 3D assets are discarded due to low texture resolution, while current super-resolution models ignore texture maps and focus on natural images. An efficient and generalizable texture super-resolution model can revitalize a large corpus of aging yet valuable assets across industries such as film and video games.

docs.title: Recurrent Sinusoidal INRs for Efficient High-Fidelity Representation
docs.text:
• 作者：Hyunmin Cho, Jaejun Yoo, Kyong Hwan Jin
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.21485v1

We study sinusoidal recurrence as an iterative mechanism for harmonic spectral enrichment in implicit neural representations (INRs). Our analysis reveals that sinusoidal activations induce a harmonic line spectrum, providing a spectral account of how recurrent unrolling enriches the effective spectral support.

docs.title: CLUIE: Clustering-Aware Recurrent Propagation with Local Structural Compensation for Underwater Image Enhancement
docs.text:
• 作者：Kui Jiang, Zefan Feng, Laibin Chang, Yan Luo, Junjun Jiang 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.21467v1

Underwater image enhancement remains challenging due to wavelength-dependent light absorption, scattering, and backscattering, which jointly cause color distortion, contrast degradation, and detail loss.

docs.title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning Model for Cross-Modality Super-Resolution in Fluorescence Microscopy
docs.text:
• 作者：Mohammad Soltaninezhad, Elena Corbetta, Francisco Paez Larios, Paul M. Jordan, Oliver Werz 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.21190v1

Cross-modality image translation offers a route to super-resolution fluorescence microscopy from low-resolution images while reducing phototoxicity and instrumentation demands. However, purely data-driven models can produce visually plausible outputs that are inconsistent with optical image formation.

docs.title: Decoupling Cross-Modality Manifold Discrepancy: Leveraging Visible Diffusion Priors for Infrared Super-Resolution
docs.text:
• 作者：Yunpeng Hua, Hongwei Yu, Jiawei Li, Qiankun Liu, Huimin Ma 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.21174v1

Infrared image super-resolution (IISR) mitigates the limitations imposed by low spatial resolution. Existing methods have recognized that IISR should preserve consistency in global distribution and structural information while enhancing image clarity.

docs.title: Causal-AgentIR: Self-Evolving Causal Memory for Adaptive Image Restoration Agents
docs.text:
• 作者：Hu Gao, Yulong Chen, Lizhuang Ma
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.21125v1

Image restoration agents have recently emerged as a flexible paradigm for handling diverse and unpredictable degradations in real-world scenarios. Existing agents typically formulate restoration as a tool-using process, where the agent perceives degradations, searches candidate tools, executes restoration operations, a…

docs.title: The Second LoViF 2026 Challenge on Real-World All-in-One Image Restoration: Methods and Results
docs.text:
• 作者：Xiang Chen, Hao Li, Jiangxin Dong, Jinshan Pan, Xin Li 等 92 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.21118v1

This paper presents a review of the second LoViF Challenge on Real-World All-in-One Image Restoration. The challenge aims to advance unified image restoration under diverse real-world degradation conditions, including blur, low-light, haze, rain, and snow.

docs.title: The RealDefocus Benchmark for Defocus Deblurring
docs.text:
• 作者：Tim Seizinger, Zhuyun Zhou, Radu Timofte
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.21078v1

Single-Image Defocus Deblurring (SIDD) aims to recover an all-in-focus image from a single defocused observation, but rigorous and reproducible evaluation remains challenging due to the scarcity of realistic, high-resolution datasets with well-aligned defocused/sharp pairs and standardized protocols.

docs.title: RealVDeblur: One-Step Diffusion for Generalizable Real-World Video Deblurring
docs.text:
• 作者：Renbiao Jin, Mingxin Yang, Yutian Chen, Junhao Zhuang, Xin Cai 等 11 人
  • 提交：2026-07-22 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.20628v1

Real-world video deblurring remains challenging due to diverse motion patterns, complex degradations, and the scarcity of realistic training data, yet robust restoration is critical for downstream pipelines such as mobile imaging and 3D reconstruction.

docs.title: MedDiT4SR: Tri-Stream Joint Adaptation of Pre-Trained Diffusion Transformers for Medical Image Super-Resolution
docs.text:
• 作者：Zhi Chen, Le Zhang
  • 提交：2026-07-22 · 分类 eess.IV · arXiv:2607.20598v1

Medical image super-resolution (MedSR) requires recovering fine anatomical structures from degraded observations while avoiding unsupported details introduced by generative priors. Large-scale pre-trained multimodal diffusion transformers provide strong visual priors, but their adaptation to MedSR remains non-trivial.

docs.title: Persian Pixel: A large-scale synthetic OCR dataset for Persian language
docs.text:
• 作者：Pouria Mahdi, Haq Nawaz Malik
  • 提交：2026-07-22 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.20385v1

Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for Persian remains substantially less mature than for Latin-script languages despite Persian being spoken by more than 110 million people across multiple countries.

docs.title: 大语言模型
MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
docs.text:
• 作者：Qian Wu, Xinrong Zhou, Zizhan Ma, Kai Chen, Zheyao Gao 等 11 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.21570v1

Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for medical education, but most existing systems focus on localized interactions such as question answering or single-turn feedback, rather than organizing an entire clinical case into a decision-centered learning trajectory.

docs.title: Beyond Sycophancy: Structured Resistance and Compliance in LLM Moral Reasoning
docs.text:
• 作者：Baihui Wang, Bernard Koch
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.21558v1

Building socially calibrated large language models, which can learn from others without simply yielding to them, requires more than reducing sycophancy as a one-dimensional failure mode. Models must distinguish when to incorporate others' perspectives from when to maintain a well-grounded moral judgment.

docs.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
docs.text:
• 作者：Wen Ye, Yuxiao Qu, Aviral Kumar, Xuezhe Ma
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.21552v1

Unlike large language models (LLMs) that exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with visual reasoning, even on geometry problems that admit equivalent text, diagram, and combined diagram+text views.

docs.title: X$^3$-OPD: Distilling Reasoning into Large Audio-Language Models via On-Policy Alignment
docs.text:
• 作者：Dongjie Fu, Di Cao, Xize Cheng, Zihan Zhang, Wenxu Jia 等 9 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2607.21550v1

While large audio-language models have achieved remarkable progress in auditory perception, they still lag behind text-based large language models in deep logical reasoning, primarily due to the scarcity of high-quality audio reasoning data.

docs.title: From Resource Flow to Executable Tests: Petri-Net-Guided LLM Test Generation for Concurrent Stateful Rust APIs
docs.text:
• 作者：Kaiwen Zhang, Guanjun Liu
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.SE · arXiv:2607.21530v1

Concurrent stateful library APIs expose behavior through evolving resource ownership, lifecycle states, and competing interleavings. Large language models can synthesize executable Rust tests, but their outputs often violate API preconditions, remain shallow, or reduce concurrency to accidental sequential traces.

docs.title: Same Dangerous Objective, Opposite Advice: Direct Exposure versus Multi-Agent Mediation
docs.text:
• 作者：Linjun Li
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.21518v1

Even a current high-capability LLM can appear safer when shown a dangerous objective directly than when other agents transform and relay its direction. Using OpenAI's gpt-5.6-sol model alias, we test 25 pre-specified mirrored trade-off profiles.

docs.title: Improved lower bounds for the Shannon capacity of odd cycles
docs.text:
• 作者：Nathaniel Itty, Christopher D. Rosin, Chase Carstensen, Daniel Reichman
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.IT · arXiv:2607.21517v1

The Shannon capacity $Θ(G)$ of a graph $G$ quantifies the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted with zero error over a noisy channel. It is lower bounded by $α(G^d)^{1/d}$ for any $d$, where $α(G^d)$ is the independence number of the $d$-th strong power of $G$.

docs.title: Artificial Epanorthosis: Why large language models overuse a classical rhetorical figure, and how to mitigate it
docs.text:
• 作者：Federico Boggia
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2607.21498v1

A rhetorical figure that Cicero and Quintilian catalogued two thousand years ago reappears, systematically, in the text of large language models: epanorthosis, the self-correction of the specimen «This is not a course. It is a journey of transformation».

docs.title: Toward Generalizable Cognitive Impairment Detection with Speech-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Yingchao Huang, Xin Wang, Yuhan Su, Shanshan Yao
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 eess.SP · arXiv:2607.21496v1

Cognitive impairment (CI) is a growing public health concern. Early and accurate diagnosis is critical for enabling timely intervention and improving patient outcomes.

docs.title: Agentic coding without the cloud: evaluating open-weight large language models on longitudinal data preparation tasks
docs.text:
• 作者：Mack Nixon, Liam Wright, Yevgeniya Kovalchuk, Alison Fang-Wei Wu, Martin Danka 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.21482v1

Large language models (LLMs) and agents are now widely used tools in code development, with data typically sent to third-party cloud-based models. Their adoption in research using personal data is constrained by governance requirements that typically prohibit data transmission to external services.

docs.title: Thinkink: 2D Spatial Ink-native Interaction with LLMs
docs.text:
• 作者：Mohammad Hasan Payandeh, Daniel Vogel, Jian Zhao
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.HC · arXiv:2607.21468v1

People often use handwritten notes and sketches to externalize ideas for ideation. To integrate large language models (LLMs) into this practice, we propose Thinkink.

docs.title: Detecting LLM-Generated Tokens in Human--LLM Coauthored Text
docs.text:
• 作者：Yangjun Lu, Hongyi Zhou, Fabian Spill, Kai Ye, Chengchun Shi 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.21458v1

The rise of human-AI collaborative writing has created a growing need for fine-grained detection methods that support localizing likely LLM-generated content in mixed-authorship documents.

docs.title: 具身智能
AXIS: A Growable Community-Driven Data Engine for Scalable Robot Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Mengfei Zhao, Dihong Huang, Yikai Tang, Peihao Li, Mingxuan Yan 等 15 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.21588v1

Learning effective robot manipulation policies requires diverse, high-quality demonstrations, yet existing data pipelines are often difficult to scale because they rely on specialized hardware, centralized operators, or fixed task suites.

docs.title: Beyond Episodic Evaluation: Memory Architectural Bottlenecks in Sequential Embodied Question Answering
docs.text:
• 作者：Zikui Cai, Kaushal Janga, Tan Dat Dao, Seungjae Lee, Shivin Dass 等 18 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.21571v1

Embodied question answering (EQA) is traditionally evaluated under an episodic formulation, where agents solve each task independently and reset internal state between episodes.

docs.title: GS-Agent: Creating 4D Physical Worlds With Generative Simulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Hongxin Zhang, Chunru Lin, Junyan Li, Zhou Xian, Tsun-Hsuan Wang 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.21522v1

Creating dynamic and physically realistic 4D worlds from natural language descriptions is both fascinating and challenging. Traditional computer graphics methods rely on manual creation, requiring extensive human effort to fine-tune materials, motions, and visual fidelity.

docs.title: VoLN: Vision-Only Long-Horizon Navigation---Paradigm, Benchmark, and Method
docs.text:
• 作者：Jiabin Lou, Haopeng Wang, Yuanshuai Wang, Xinyu Liu, Xuxin Lv 等 9 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.21400v1

Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) enables embodied agents to follow natural-language instructions. However, route-level instructions commonly encode spatial priors, such as orientation, distance, and layout, that are not explicitly available from onboard sensing at deployment in open, GPS-denied environments.

docs.title: TableVerse: A Large-scale Tabletop Dataset with Real-world Grounded Layouts for Generalizable Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Boyuan Wang, Yue Zhang, Xutao Xue, Xueyu Song, Yu Sun
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.21017v1

The development of generalizable robotic manipulation policies is inherently bounded by the availability of large-scale, high-fidelity scene data. While recent automated synthesis methods attempt to bridge this gap via text-to-layout hallucination or simplified procedural generation, they frequently suffer from physica…

docs.title: HyWorldVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Hybrid World Modeling for Autonomous Driving
docs.text:
• 作者：Quanfu Yu, Xian Wu, Hao Xu, Liulong Ma
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2607.20988v1

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models augmented with world modeling represent a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving. While pixel-level future prediction enables fine-grained spatiotemporal reasoning, it compromises robustness in noisy driving scenarios.

docs.title: URF: A Unified Robot Control-Policy Framework for Stable Contact Aware Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Jiyou Shin, Youngjin Seo, Jaeseog Won, Sungwon Seo, Hyunjun Kim 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.20912v1

Learning-based manipulation policies usually predict robot actions from sensory observations and leave their execution to a separate low-level controller. In rigid contact, this separation can be problematic: the same motion to a virtual target or compliant motion command can lead to unstable contact, tracking error, e…

docs.title: Robostral Navigate
docs.text:
• 作者：Arjun Majumdar, Avinash Sooriyarachchi, Benjamin Tibi, Chris Bamford, Elliot Chane-Sane 等 14 人
  • 提交：2026-07-22 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.20785v1

Deploying navigation systems at scale requires a recipe that minimizes sensor assumptions, generalizes across robot embodiments, and trains efficiently. Yet, today's best systems depend on depth sensors, multi-camera rigs, or pre-built maps, limiting the hardware they support and increasing deployment cost.

docs.title: Towards Capability-Aware Traversability Navigation for Unstructured Environments
docs.text:
• 作者：Gianluca Capezzuto, Felipe Tommaselli, Matheus P. Angarola, Ricardo V. Godoy, Marcelo Becker
  • 提交：2026-07-22 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.20679v1

Estimating traversability in unstructured environments requires conditioning on robot embodiment, as the same terrain can be traversable for one platform and unsafe for another.

docs.title: Closing the Lab-to-Store Gap: A Data-Efficient Post-Training and Experience-Driven Learning VLA Framework for Retail Humanoids
docs.text:
• 作者：Roger Sala Sisó, Tiago Silvério, Jakob Sand, Tran Nguyen Le
  • 提交：2026-07-22 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.20345v1

Closing the gap between benchmark performance and reliable real-world operation remains a central challenge for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) humanoid robots, which must handle execution errors, distribution shifts, and environmental variability.

docs.title: SeededGrasp: Language-Guided Grasping in Complex Scenes with Multiple Embodiments
docs.text:
• 作者：Yang Xu, Gurpreet Singh Mukker, Raymond Wang, Jasper Gerigk, Maria Attarian 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-07-22 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.20207v1

Practical robotic grasping in complex scenes requires both 3D spatial reasoning and alignment with task-specific requirements. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a natural way to specify these requirements using language, but existing approaches either use a VLM to predict the grasp directly with limited spatial aware…

docs.title: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
docs.text:

  • 提交：2026-07-22 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2607.20061v1

Embodied visual tracking (EVT) requires a mobile agent to continuously follow a specific target described in natural language using only onboard vision. • 作者：Jim Woodcock, Gabriel Leite, Augusto Sampaio, Ran Wei
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.SE · arXiv:2608.13459v1

We address the use of large language models (LLMs) to help discover Isabelle proofs. An Isabelle build establishes that the submitted theory is accepted, but not that an LLM changed only what the developer authorised.

docs.title: LLM-Assisted Dynamic Threat Analysis for Attacker-Reachable Software Weaknesses in Autonomous Vehicles
docs.text:
• 作者：Md Wasiul Haque, Sagar Dasgupta, Mizanur Rahman, Md Rayhanur Rahman
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.SE · arXiv:2608.13450v1

Autonomous vehicles depend on large safety-critical software stacks, where weaknesses reachable from adversarial inputs may affect steering, braking, or other control decisions.

docs.title: Are You Sure You're Sure? On the Impact of Instruction Tuning on Confidence and Lexical Diversity
docs.text:
• 作者：Irina Proskurina, Mayank Kumar, Oyindolapo O. Komolafe
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.13430v1

Instruction-tuned language models achieve strong performance across a range of generation tasks, but have also recently been shown to exhibit verbalized overconfidence. In question answering, verbalized model overconfidence may be associated with the consistency of the generated supporting rationales.

docs.title: 具身智能
Decoding Task Progress from VLA Representations
docs.text:
• 作者：Atiksh Bhardwaj, Edward Weiyi Duan, Prithwish Dan, Wei-Chiu Ma, Preston Culbertson
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.13474v1

Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are moving rapidly towards deployment as general-purpose manipulation policies, but we currently lack basic tools for understanding what these models represent internally or for monitoring them at runtime.

docs.title: UniTexture: Cross-Task Universal Adversarial Textures for Vision-Language-Action Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Yukun Dai, Mingzhe Dai, Tianshi Wang, Fengling Li, Jingjing Li 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.13453v1

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as generalist robotic policies capable of following diverse language instructions and performing a wide range of manipulation tasks.

docs.title: Enhancing Virtual Agents through SLMs and Edge-Computing: An Exploratory Evaluation of Think and Memory Processes
docs.text:
• 作者：Aimilios Hadjiliasi, Louis Nisiotis
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.13420v1

Embodied intelligent virtual agents are expected to operate as persistent, adaptive, and context-aware entities within complex virtual and Metaverse worlds. However, implementing cognitively capable agents in such environments is conceptually and technologically challenging.

docs.title: FIRE-VLA: Failure-Informed Self-Evolution for Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
docs.text:
• 作者：Hao Dou
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.13395v1

Reinforcement learning improves autonomous-driving vision-language-action (VLA) models by evaluating trajectories sampled from the current policy. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) learns from reward differences within each rollout group.

docs.text:
• 作者：Nico Heider, Michał Jan Włodarczyk, Katarzyna Wasielewska-Michniewska, Przemysław Hołda, Martin Schieck 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.13095v1

Training and evaluating spatial reasoning in embodied agents requires diverse environments that are both geometrically faithful and semantically queryable. Synthetic simulators offer ground truth semantics but sacrifice realism; simulators based on reconstructions of real-world environments have realistic appearance bu…

docs.title: H2R-Bench: Benchmarking Human-to-Robot Manipulation Video Generation in World Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Dingyi Rong, Yue Shi, Chaofan Ma, Jiezhang Cao, Zongrui Wang 等 9 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.13049v1

Large-scale manipulation data is essential for robot learning, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains expensive and difficult to scale. Meanwhile, abundant egocentric human manipulation videos provide rich behavioral experiences, but transferring them across embodiments remains challenging due to differences betwe…

docs.title: Temporal GRPO: Beyond Trajectory-Level Credit in Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
docs.text:
• 作者：Yao Zhou, Hang Gao, Fengge Wu, Changwen Zheng, Wenwen Qiang
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.13026v1

Outcome-driven reinforcement learning offers a scalable way to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) policies from sparse task-success feedback. In common GRPO-based VLA post-training, one rollout-level advantage is applied to every action in the trajectory.

docs.title: FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference for Autonomous Driving
docs.text:
• 作者：Zekai Li, Yihao Liang, Hongfei Zhang, Jian Chen, Yesheng Liang 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.12932v1

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise to bring end-to-end reasoning to autonomous driving, but their computational cost remains far too high for real-time control. The core challenge is structural: VLA inference is not a single bottleneck but a cascade of four.

docs.title: HumanoidVLN: A Physics-Grounded Simulator and Benchmark for Vision-Language Navigation Across Diverse Humanoid Embodiments
docs.text:
• 作者：Quan-Dung Pham, Anh Dao, The-Anh Nguyen, Minh Nguyen-Dinh, Phuong Nam Dang 等 11 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.12860v1

Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) for humanoid robots poses challenges existing benchmarks fail to address: bipedal locomotion imposes physical constraints absent from wheeled agents, humanoid morphologies vary across platforms, and egocentric observations are distorted by locomotion-induced camera dynamics.

docs.title: BrainWAM: Action-Space Coordination of Semantic Priors and Predictive Dynamics for Autonomous Driving
docs.text:
• 作者：Bing Zhan, Shuyao Shang, Jiahao Gu, Shuo Lu, Yuan Xu 等 11 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.12854v1

Autonomous driving requires planning under both semantic constraints and predictive dynamics. Existing end-to-end driving approaches, however, typically emphasize only one side of this requirement: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exploit VLM priors for semantic reasoning, while World Action Models (WAMs) provide fu…

docs.title: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence
docs.text:
• 作者：Haokai Zhang, Yuhang Ding, Yunshu Zhou, Xinze Du, Shengtao Zhang 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.12743v1

Spatial intelligence is becoming a foundation for embodied agents, robotic planning, and multimodal assistants. To improve the spatial reasoning ability of VLM agents, existing work has mainly followed two lines. One line uses post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

docs.title: FUSE: Active Functional Affordance Grounding through Adaptive Semantic-Geometric Evidence Acquisition
docs.text:
• 作者：Zhou Chen, Sathyanarayanan N. Aakur
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.12683v1

Embodied agents must often identify and interact with objects based on their function rather than their identity, requiring them to actively acquire observations that reveal discriminative functional evidence.

docs.title: 大语言模型
QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures
docs.text:
• 作者：Shangao Li, Yao Zhang, Volker Tresp, Yuanyuan Yang
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.13547v1

LLM coding agents issue Bash commands through interfaces that may serialize, wrap, and reparse model output. Matched execution scores alone cannot distinguish command-generation errors from failures introduced after generation.

docs.title: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
docs.text:
• 作者：Fanfei Li, Jana Zeller, Manuel Prada-Corral, Thaddäus Wiedemer, Prasanna Mayilvahanan 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.13545v1

Modern language models are trained on heterogeneous web-scale text corpora. Consequently, studying knowledge and skill acquisition is difficult, as prior exposure to related content is hard to characterize.

docs.title: SAEVerbalizer: Generating Explanations for Sparse Autoencoder Features via Representation Verbalization
docs.text:
• 作者：Weihan Meng, Hongzhu Guo, Yi Jing, Dewen Liu, Zijun Yao 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.13538v1

Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are proposed to extract numerous features from large language model (LLM) representations, yet explaining these features still relies primarily on external observation.

docs.title: DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters Using Only Permissible Post-Training Data
docs.text:
• 作者：Peter Schneider-Kamp, Jacob Nielsen, Gianluca Barmina, Kenneth Enevoldsen, Lukas Galke Poech
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.13517v1

Current large language model development relies on massive, often non-permissible datasets, creating a high barrier for researchers committed to open-source and ethically sourced data.

docs.title: On the Structural Limits of Machine Learning Decision Systems: An Information-Theoretic, Interaction-Based, and Stochastic-Dynamical Perspective
docs.text:
• 作者：Nestor R. Barraza, Gabriel Pena
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 math.ST · arXiv:2608.13510v1

Machine learning procedures are commonly evaluated in terms of predictive accuracy and computational efficiency. However, their achievable performance is fundamentally constrained by structural properties of the underlying data-generating process, which are formalized in terms of informational bounds.

docs.title: Toward a Gricean Retreat: Probing LLMs for Knowledge Boundaries and Referent Specificity
docs.text:
• 作者：Dananjay Srinivas, Saksham Khatwani, Maria Pacheco
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.13484v1

When asked about entities outside their knowledge boundary, LLMs routinely fabricate plausible-sounding details rather than backing off to safer, more general claims.

docs.title: MARC v1: An Open-Source Multi-Agent Framework for Clinical AI Reasoning and Coordination
docs.text:
• 作者：Saisha Shetty, Satvik Tripathi, Austin Lin, Colin Zhao, Theodore Kim 等 9 人
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.13476v1

We present Multi-Agent Reasoning and Coordination (MARC), an open-source framework that replaces monolithic LLM prompting with deterministic multi-agent orchestration for clinical reasoning.

docs.title: AaLLM: An End-to-End Analog Circuit Design Framework from Topology Generation to Sizing Using Large Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Mohammed Ayman Habib, Rylan Hart, Morteza Fayazi
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 eess.SY · arXiv:2608.13472v1

Analog circuit design is a time-consuming, iterative process in a nonlinear and high-dimensional design space that relies heavily on expert intuition. Among recent developments, LLMs have introduced a promising approach by bringing natural language reasoning to circuit design tasks.

docs.title: MLLM-Routed Heterogeneous Ensembles for Robust Cross-Dataset Image Classification
docs.text:
• 作者：Daniel Perkins, John Squires, Janou Milligan, Chandra Raskoti, Linda Ungerboeck
  • 提交：2026-08-13 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.13463v1

Modern image classification models excel when trained on single task-specific datasets but often struggle to generalize across domains and difficulty levels. We propose ARMDIL, an Adaptive Router for Multi-Domain Image classification with LLMs.
