docs.title: 图像复原 / 低层视觉
PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer
docs.text:
• 作者：Lingchen Sun, Rongyuan Wu, Xiangtao Kong, Jixin Zhao, Qiaosi Yi 等 9 人
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.16793v1

Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors.

docs.title: Binarized High-Efficiency RAW Video Restoration and Beyond
docs.text:
• 作者：Tianyu Zhu, Ying Fu, Hesong Li, Gengchen Zhang, Xin Yuan 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.16756v1

RAW video restoration is fundamental to high-quality low-level perception and serves as the basis for a wide range of downstream vision applications. While binary neural networks (BNNs) enable efficient lightweight deployment for image enhancement, their deficiencies in modeling temporal coherence and activation value…

docs.title: Supervising the Path to Fine Scales: GalerkinFlow for Scientific-Field and Image Super-Resolution
docs.text:
• 作者：Zikang Zhan
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.16546v1

Most super-resolution models learn from paired data by supervising only the final high-resolution output. This provides little control over how the prediction should evolve between the downsampled observation and its fine target.

docs.title: 大语言模型
Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
docs.text:
• 作者：Bingxin Xu, Yuzhang Shang, Emilio Ferrara
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.16889v1

Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly master the individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next.

docs.title: Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning
docs.text:
• 作者：Minh-Ha Nguyen, Cathy Shyr
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.16831v1

Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations.

docs.title: When State Becomes an Attack Surface: State-Semantic Injection in LLM-Driven Embodied Agents
docs.text:
• 作者：Jiawei Liu, Jiacheng Guo, Tian Zhang, Yiwei Xu, Juan Wang 等 10 人
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.16806v1

Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated capabilities in in-context learning, task decomposition, step-by-step reasoning, and code generation, driving their gradual evolution from text generation models into the core of agents capable of perceiving environments, invoking tools, and executing tasks.

docs.title: Historical Backtesting for Scientific Question Discovery: A Protocol and Astronomy Pilot
docs.text:
• 作者：Hui Mao
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.CE · arXiv:2608.16795v1

Systems that generate scientific research questions are evaluated today by expert scores, LLM-as-judge ratings, or curated case studies -- all subjective, none falsifiable.

docs.title: GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises
docs.text:
• 作者：Lirui Teng
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.16776v1

High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance.

docs.title: Topological Attribution Distance (TAD): Revealing Segment-Level RAG Influence on LLM Output Geometry for Incident Log Analysis
docs.text:
• 作者：Reza Fayyazi, Michael Zuzak, Shanchieh Jay Yang
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.CR · arXiv:2608.16775v1

Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in cybersecurity operations to assist cybersecurity analysts with rapid decision-making against emerging threats. However, there is a main criteria that must be met when using LLMs in cybersecurity, that is, trust in the generated outputs.

docs.title: LAVA: Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation Framework for Large-Scale Financial Document Auditing
docs.text:
• 作者：Ruoqi Shu, Xuhui Wang, Isaac Wang, Yanming Mai, Bo Wan
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.16763v1

Financial document validation in production, such as payroll auditing, tax compliance, and loan underwriting, demands exceptional accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility under strict enterprise constraints.

docs.title: On the Principles Behind Neural Network Optimizers
docs.text:
• 作者：Yushun Zhang
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2608.16760v1

Reliable optimization is central to neural network (NN) training, yet Adam, the default optimizer for modern LLMs, rests on a fragile foundation. This thesis develops a principled grounding for Adam and motivates new designs.

docs.title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments
docs.text:
• 作者：Adam Karvonen, Euan Ong, Subhash Kantamneni, Samuel Marks
  • 提交：2026-08-17 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2608.16747v1

Many areas of AI research, such as language model interpretability and chain of thought faithfulness, seek to explain model behaviors. But what constitutes a "good" explanation? docs.title: From Threat Intelligence to Detection: Knowledge-driven Enrichment and Template-based Rule Grounding for Automated Sigma Rule Generation
docs.text:
• 作者：Sepehr Ghaffarzadegan, Boubakr Nour, Makan Pourzandi, Mourad Debbabi, Chadi Assi
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.CR · arXiv:2608.19011v1

Mechanisms for dynamically converting cyber threat intelligence (CTI) into actionable detection capabilities are necessary due to the rapid evolution of Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs).

docs.title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning
docs.text:
• 作者：Yajie Yin
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.19009v1

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly paired with verifiers (step checkers, self-consistency filters, tool-based fact checkers, formal proof assistants) that claim to detect the model's errors.

docs.title: A Theory of Post-hoc Debate Judgement
docs.text:
• 作者：Xiang Yin, Adam Dejl, Antonio Rago, Lihu Chen, Francesca Toni
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.19002v1

Debates have recently emerged as a useful methodology for agentic AI to improve performance as well as to aid explainability and user engagement. For example, LLM-empowered agents may debate internally (with themselves) and/or externally (with other agents).

docs.title: DeepWeaver: Bridging the Evidence Synthesis Gap in Open-Ended Question Answering
docs.text:
• 作者：Xujia Wang, Yizhe Zhang, Bin Xu, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.18988v1

Retrieve-then-generate pipelines are commonly used to produce deep-research answers for open-ended questions, but retrieval alone is insufficient: LLMs must organize noisy and fragmented evidence into comprehensive, well-cited answers. We refer to this process as evidence synthesis.

docs.title: rEDMRec: Distilling Large Language Model Reasoning into an Editable Experience Memory for Recommendation
docs.text:
• 作者：Minh Hoang Nguyen, Tung Le, Huy Tien Nguyen
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.IR · arXiv:2608.18952v1

Large language models can improve recommendation quality by reasoning explicitly over user history and candidate items - for example, extracting a user's preferences or explaining why one item fits better than another - rather than mapping history directly to a ranked list.

docs.title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
docs.text:
• 作者：Bogdan Zagribelnyy, Ivan Ilin, Nikita Bondarev, Maksim Kuznetsov, Mathieu Reymond 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2608.18940v1

Single-step retrosynthesis is a central component of computer-aided synthesis planning, yet its intrinsically one-to-many nature is poorly captured by single-answer evaluation and benchmarking protocols.

docs.title: 具身智能
ADEPT: Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training and Post-Training using Reinforcement Learning
docs.text:
• 作者：Jayjun Lee, Jessica Yin, Asif Rana, Nicholas Blauch, Sam Mady 等 10 人
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.19182v1

We introduce Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training (ADEPT), a large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning sim-to-real transferable dexterity across high degree-of-freedom (DoF) robot embodiments that can solve long-horizon tasks directly from raw visuo-tactile perception.

docs.text:
• 作者：George Andrikopoulos
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.19140v1

Frontier language models are compared, marketed, and benchmarked on capability -- what their best or average output can achieve. I argue this measures the wrong axis. The models have saturated accuracy: their mean output lands on the target.

docs.text:

  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.19066v1

docs.text:
• 作者：Yaowei Guo, Zeng Tao, Yuxin Jiang, Yunuo Chen, Zhiyang Dou 等 10 人
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.18948v1

We present RoboEdit, a human-to-robot video editing suite that transforms human manipulation videos into action-consistent, physically plausible robot videos with aligned…

docs.text:

Indoor scene synthesis provides essential environments for embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy learning. Recent code-based scene generation methods produce editable and extensible environments, yet they remain focused on visual construction and object-level articulation, leaving the functiona…

docs.title: The Embodiment Gap in Robot Foundation Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Yukiyasu Domae, Keisuke Shirai, Hanbit Oh, Ryoichi Nakajo, Tomohiro Motoda 等 10 人
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.18433v1

Robot foundation models (RFMs), including vision-language-action (VLA) policies, are often discussed through a scaling view: more data, larger models, and broader benchmarks should improve generalization.

docs.title: Role-Conditioned Sub-Token Routing for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policies
docs.text:
• 作者：Wei Jiang, Wei Wang
  • 提交：2026-08-19 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2608.18410v1

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models process long multimodal token sequences, making inference expensive in both memory and computation. Existing efficiency methods mainly reduce visual tokens, but aggressive token pruning becomes fragile because removing a token discards its entire representation.

docs.title: GuideFetch: A Task Coordination Framework for Concurrent Navigation and Object Retrieval in Assistive Robot Dogs
docs.text:

  • 提交：2026-08-18 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.18292v1

Consider a robot guide dog escorting a blind user to an available seat while a second assistive robot dog concurrently retrieves a cup of coffee and delivers it to the same seat. This setting motivates concurrent execution because navigation and object retrieval can overlap.

docs.title: Revisiting the "Push-T" Robot Manipulation Task with Agentic Robotics
docs.text:
• 作者：Shuangyu Xie, Kaiyuan Chen, Ken Goldberg
  • 提交：2026-08-18 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.18227v1

Push-T is an iconic benchmark for learning manipulation policies from human demonstrations. The robot must use a single point of contact to push a T-shaped block into a target pose.

docs.text:

A robot asked to "place the cup near the red plate or the blue plate" may reach the centroid between them and appear geometrically successful, while satisfying neither disjunct of the instruction.

docs.text:

docs.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
docs.text:
• 作者：Atsuyuki Miyai, Kiyoharu Aizawa, Toshihiko Yamasaki
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.20169v1

We present a novel approach to efficient LLM agent harness optimization through adaptive validation task selection. Harness optimization iteratively rewrites the harness code based on validation performance, enabling substantial performance gains without updating the underlying model weights.

DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation

Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions.

docs.text:

The convergence of large language models (LLMs), structured knowledge bases (KBs), and reasoning ability (RA) presents a promising trajectory toward general embodied intelligence (GEI).

Vision-language-model-based embodied agents can complete instructed tasks but often violate safety constraints in the process, a problem recently framed as interactive safety.

Pretrained Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for robot learning, but sequentially adapting them to diverse skills can perturb the representations and velocity mappings used by previous skills, leading to catastrophic forgetting.

State-of-the-art vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ exhibit strong semantic understanding, instruction following and task behavior. However, when deployed on new robots, even minor mismatches in hardware configuration relative to pretraining can cause severe performance drops.

Legal work, with its heavy reliance on processing large amounts of text, is often considered one of the domains most exposed to the use of LLMs. Contract ``scrubbing,'' the final review of transactional agreements for errors and inconsistencies, is a particularly suitable task for automation, because it is routine, pai…

However, existing memory benchmarks mainly evaluate whether information is correctly extracted, stored, and retrieved, while largely overlooking how retrieved memories reshape model rea…

Non-invasive decoding of inner speech faces a fundamental data problem: a corpus pairing brain activity with a person's spontaneous inner monologue cannot be collected, and the available proxy paradigms (cued repetitive and retrospectively reported generative inner speech) are slow to acquire, poorly time-locked, and s…

docs.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
docs.text:
• 作者：Atsuyuki Miyai, Kiyoharu Aizawa, Toshihiko Yamasaki
  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.20169v1

We present a novel approach to efficient LLM agent harness optimization through adaptive validation task selection. Harness optimization iteratively rewrites the harness code based on validation performance, enabling substantial performance gains without updating the underlying model weights.

docs.title: 具身智能
DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation

  • 提交：2026-08-20 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.20114v1

Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions.

End-to-end autonomous driving has evolved from camera-to-control regression toward planning-oriented systems that use structured representations, trajectory-level outputs, and increasingly realistic evaluation protocols.

How to efficiently finetune robot policies to learn new tasks on the fly? State of the art robotic manipulation policies are based on behaviour cloning of large vision-language-action (VLA) models with billions of parameters on huge teleoperation datasets.

The convergence of large language models (LLMs), structured knowledge bases (KBs), and reasoning ability (RA) presents a promising trajectory toward general embodied intelligence (GEI).

Pretrained Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for robot learning, but sequentially adapting them to diverse skills can perturb the representations and velocity mappings used by previous skills, leading to catastrophic forgetting.
